QuestInfo.name: New World, New Skills
QuestInfo.0: #bGen#k should be able to help you start your training in the new world.
QuestInfo.1: Gen says the Heliseum branch will make preparations for your trip to the new world and contact you soon.
QuestInfo.2: The Heliseum branch said you need to visit #bFenelle#k in #bPantheon Great Temple Interior#k.

0.0: Looks like you made up your mind. You'll need to get into Pantheon's Great Temple and use their Interdimensional Portal.\r\n
0.1: The Shadowdealers of Heliseum will help you out. They'll get in touch with you soon.\r\n

yes.0: Keep a low profile. I didn't tell them who you are, and if there's a brain in that thick skull of yours, you'll do the same.\r\n

0.msg: Someone's radioing me. Is it my contact with Heliseum's Shadowdealers?\r\n

1.msg: Hey, this is Romero, top Shadowdealer in Heliseum. I took care of things on my end, so you're clear to go to the Great Temple in Pantheon.\r\n

2.msg: Find Fenelle and tell her the Shadowdealers sent you. She'll take care of you. Well... good luck.\r\n

3.msg: #b(It feels strange to return to Pantheon. Surely nobody will recognize you after all these years...)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

default.0: The Heliseum Shadowdealers will take good care of you. To a point.\r\n
